title: Eleanor Weekender — Old Money — Nine Ad Storyboards
summary: Three aspirational fashion openings × Anna, eurofall-weekender-C3 and mer-oldmoney-C1. Each hook displays four distinct coveted Birkin-style designer bags; Eleanor does not appear until its named introduction. The desired outcome is the old-money silhouette without the designer expenditure. Existing shared Weekender footage and approved narration remain. No on-screen text; timing provisional.

beats.script: Everyone wants that old money look until the bag costs more than the trip.
beats.visual: Four coveted Birkin-style designer bags: black grained leather with cream tailoring; golden tan on walnut; taupe with navy trousers; burgundy on an ivory chair.
beats.emotion: Desire — makes the coveted old-money silhouette tangible in four distinct finishes. Let the voice carry the price contrast while the picture stays aspirational.

notes.title: LATEST DIRECTION — OLD-MONEY DESIRE
notes.text: The audience covets the Birkin silhouette and wants that style without the designer expenditure. Hooks show four different beautiful designer-style bags. No Eleanor in a hook; no failed solutions, battered bags, price-shock faces or before/after. Presenter bridges lead to the named Eleanor introduction. No text anywhere in ad footage.

notes.title: VOICE — EXACT REQUEST
notes.text: Woman Over 40 · ElevenLabs Eleven V3 · Creative. Stability 0.0; similarity 0.85. Raw friend-to-friend read: natural breaths, varied emphasis, no announcer cadence or forced rasp. One continuous take per hook, shared across its three avatars. Audio generation and audible quality review are pending.

notes.title: HOW TO READ THE BOARD
notes.text: Nine ads = three complete sequences × three existing avatars. Start with the hook previews and avatar roster, then the nine combinations. Each H1/H2/H3 sequence continues left-to-right through its numbered sections. All approved words are preserved. A1 previews stand in for the selected avatar on presenter-only cards.

notes.title: NO SCREEN TEXT + LAYERING
notes.text: All nine ads: no on-screen text. No subtitles, captions, hook headlines, comparison labels, product titles or CTA overlays. 9:16; avatar approximately 30–35% width at the grid intersection, clear of faces, handles and hardware. Keep the chosen identity throughout.

notes.title: EDIT + SOUND
notes.text: Aspirational designer grids open each ad; cut to the presenter at the bridge, then reveal Eleanor at C01. Direct cuts follow spoken cues. Dry raw voice forward; optional restrained music. No comparison edits, shocked reactions or on-screen text. Align timing to final voice.

notes.text: Final line names the Eleanor Weekender in the voice only. Hold the clean product image for 1.2 seconds after the last word. No CTA text, titles, sale or scarcity graphics. Existing end-frame plate is selected on C13.

notes.text: Shared coverage uses the existing Weekender library; no new common-body B-roll. All bridges hold on the presenter. Travel and mirror inserts appear once in each body at C02/C03. Cross-ad reuse is intentional. Older brand library images are generated assets, not documentary customer footage.

notes.text: Three new designer-bag grids inspected: four different desirable all-leather bags per grid, no Eleanor canvas/oval hardware, no visible text or reaction/comparison scenes.
